comment: Tool governance for agents onboarded with this kit. Default deny: a tool that is not listed does not run. requires_approval tools are refused by unattended runtimes and routed to a human approval flow in production deployments.

get_weather.comment: Read-only, low-risk lookup. The kind of tool an agent should be able to use without waking a human.

send_external_email.comment: Outbound communication leaves the tenant boundary and cannot be unsent - a human approves each use, or the tool stays off.
